tasks.title: Choose a public feeder and metrics
tasks.acceptance: Record source, license, units, topology and reference outputs; justify voltage/loading bounds and numerical tolerances.

tasks.title: Specify data and engine decisions
tasks.acceptance: Review exact dependency candidates, profiles, rights and supported hardware; distinguish synthetic profiles from observed data.

tasks.title: Build the scenario skeleton
tasks.acceptance: A local CLI rejects inconsistent units and dangling network references; its synthetic balance test is hand-checkable.

tasks.title: Integrate the network baseline
tasks.acceptance: Match a public reference power-flow case and retain convergence and residual diagnostics.

tasks.title: Add transformer loss and thermal state
tasks.acceptance: Compare the reduced-order model with a documented reference; reject unsupported temperature and load ranges.

tasks.title: Validate time-series coupling
tasks.acceptance: Power-to-energy integration uses explicit intervals; no hidden energy appears at component boundaries.

tasks.title: Implement baseline and candidate schedules
tasks.acceptance: Compare fixed operating policy, bounded tap changes and storage scheduling under identical profiles.

tasks.title: Add feasibility-first ranking
tasks.acceptance: Any candidate violating voltage, loading or storage constraints is excluded with an inspectable reason.

tasks.title: Generate the energy comparison report
tasks.acceptance: Show losses, served energy, limit violations, cost assumptions and full reproduction inputs for every arm.

tasks.title: Create load and weather holdouts
tasks.acceptance: Separate selection and confirmation periods; report performance over heat and peak-demand conditions.

tasks.title: Test outages and degraded components
tasks.acceptance: Evaluate explicitly enumerated contingencies and unserved energy without live infrastructure access.

tasks.title: Cross-check numerical assumptions
tasks.acceptance: Detect nonconvergence, unit mistakes and misleading aggregate efficiency; compare a second reference where available.

tasks.title: Add generation-storage planning
tasks.acceptance: Compare scenarios with explicit capacity, degradation, weather and resource assumptions and feasible energy balances.

tasks.title: Specify and validate higher-fidelity transformer models
tasks.acceptance: Require reusable material data, mesh/timestep convergence and a reduced-order comparison before claiming component gains.

tasks.title: Add lifecycle and novel-concept comparisons
tasks.acceptance: Expose construction/operation/end-of-life assumptions; speculative designs remain hypotheses and cannot violate conservation.

tasks.title: Build evidence-grounded design proposals
tasks.acceptance: Every proposed change lists source assumptions, bounds and a measurable engineering hypothesis.

tasks.title: Run equal-budget optimization baselines
tasks.acceptance: Compare agent-guided search with grid/random baselines; enforce the same solver and resource budget.

tasks.title: Confirm robust Pareto candidates
tasks.acceptance: Retest selected designs on untouched scenarios and report tradeoffs, failures and uncertainty.

tasks.title: Build a local network comparison view
tasks.acceptance: Show units, constraints and failures with keyboard access; a network drawing is labeled as a simulated model.

tasks.title: Add isolated batch execution
tasks.acceptance: Enforce resource limits, cancellation and restart recovery without duplicate run publication.

tasks.title: Export portable energy studies
tasks.acceptance: A fresh machine reconstructs inputs and results from a bundle without private provider access.

tasks.title: Replicate a second network
tasks.acceptance: A new topology exercises the same pipeline; document which assumptions fail to transfer.

tasks.title: Conduct an engineering review
tasks.acceptance: A qualified reviewer checks feasibility, model scope and the claimed operating/design improvements.

tasks.title: Prepare the research preview
tasks.acceptance: Include reproducible cases, known limits and maintainer-approved release notes without real-grid deployment claims.
